additional_review.reason: Division/remainder/modulo zero and GLSL Pow/Atan2/FMin/FMax now have scalar32 and direct 2-4 component vector adaptations in the first compute entry block. Literal uint32-to-float32 bitcasts are supported. FMin/FMax NaN is portability advice under current Khronos wording, not an invalid-instruction claim. Both Godot compilers reject out-of-range ImageGather components through the existing shader-compile-error rule. General dynamic operands, other widths, later blocks and cooperative-matrix runtime address/alignment checks remain outside observation. Since 1.16, applicable resource/operand checks inspect each public imported shader stage independently, including Godot 4.7 ray stages; workgroup checks remain compute-only. Stage quantities are not summed across unverified pipelines.
